answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake behind a single hardware-verified key, like a dune that shifts unless anchored: creating a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand stakes, soon unaffordable. Honest agents earn the stake back from the emission pool, while duplicate signing or spam triggers slashing. A lotus rises from one rooted stem, and likewise one key maps to one voice. A shared lagoon of attested work lets peers check real work before the stake is released, so flooding the network costs the attacker real capital, not cheap copies.
